primary_task: For an NVIDIA-related request, check the live NVIDIA skills catalog and recommend up to three matching skills with install commands (without installing unless approved).

requirements.name: NVIDIA skills catalog lookup: `npx skills add nvidia/skills --list`, or github.com/NVIDIA/skills, or raw.githubusercontent.com skills.sh.json, or build.nvidia.com (any one suffices)
requirements.evidence: 'Catalog check means one of: - `npx skills add nvidia/skills --list` - https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills/tree/main/skills - https://build.nvidia.com/skills - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/skills/main/skills.sh.json'
requirements.basis: 'GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com)' and npm are open; only build.nvidia.com is refused (NVIDIA hosts), and it is one of several alternatives.

requirements.name: npx (skills CLI)
requirements.evidence: 'When shell access is available, attempt this command first: npx skills add nvidia/skills --list'
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, ...)'.

requirements.name: ask the user for approval before installing
requirements.evidence: 'Ask before installing. Do not run `npx skills add` unless the user approves.'
requirements.basis: tools: 'ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation'.

requirements.name: NVIDIA GPU
requirements.evidence: No step in the document runs GPU code; it only recommends skills ('Recommending a skill is always allowed once the request is relevant').
requirements.basis: lacks: 'a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)'. Not required by this document.

notes: Reading taken: the deliverable is a catalog lookup plus a recommendation, not installation or GPU work. A downstream recommended NVIDIA skill might need a GPU, but that is outside this document.
